simple.meaning: תֶּבֶל (tebel) is a Hebrew word meaning “mixture , i.e. unnatural bestiality.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תֶּבֶל (H8397) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 18:23, with occurrences in Leviticus.
